newsitem.title: COLOMBIA: Colombia's Comcel posts heavy first-quarter loss.
newsitem.headline: Colombia's Comcel posts heavy first-quarter loss.

text.p: Colombia's Comunicacion Celular SA (Comcel) reported a net loss of 8.2 billion pesos in the first quarter, up substantially from a net loss of 698 million pesos in the same period last year.
The company, one of six firms competing in Colombia's fast-growing cellular telephone market, gave no specific reason for the loss in a first-quarter earnings statement.

The statement said first-quarter operating income increased to 7.3 billion pesos from 3.7 billion in the year- ago period. It added that revenues for the quarter were 57.3 billion pesos compared with just over 37 billion a year ago.
